name: Recipe Pocket
description: Read the recipe on the current page in a clean view. Save locally, scale, convert, list and print. No account, no analytics.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; connect-src 'none'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; frame-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
